programme.title: Ancient Worlds
programme.sub-title: City of Man, City of God
programme.desc: Richard Miles explores the rise and fall of the Roman empire, which at the height of its power, extended the benefits of its civilisation to a staggering 60 million subjects and citizens, from Hadrian's Wall to the banks of the Euphrates. The archaeologist and historian also learns how the expansion of Christianity filled a gap left by the Roman multi-god belief system, eventually leading to the instalment of Constantine as the first Christian emperor

programme.title: The Normans
programme.desc: Professor Robert Bartlett examines the impact of the conquest of Britain and Ireland, and learns how William the Conqueror built scores of castles and cathedrals to impose his control and intimidate the population. The ruler also commissioned the Domesday Book to survey the wealth of the land and raise revenue, and set in motion the linguistic and cultural transformation of England. The Normans blended well in Scotland, but faced fierce opposition in Wales, and promoted divisions in Ireland which some claim still exist to this day

programme.title: Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: Professor Ben Garrod explores how animals' skin acts as a barrier between them and the outside world, shielding them from extremes of temperature, harmful effects of UV and organisms

programme.title: Gareth Edwards' Great Welsh Adventure
programme.desc: In the Brecon Beacons, Gareth and wife Maureen inspect their accommodation - a shepherd's hut complete with lush rolling hills for a view and sheep for neighbours. Out and about, they receive a lesson in controlling a full-sized tank, with Maureen keen to see how the vehicle can pick up speed. After getting some tips from champion clay pigeon shooter Rhys Lewis, photographer Rhian Mai meets the pair at a spectacular natural cave to help hone their skills in capturing the scene. The weekend ends where the original adventure began - on one of Wales' most beautiful canals

programme.title: How the Romans Conquered the Alps
programme.desc: Exploring Emperor Augustus's Alpine campaign, revealing the route, weapons and tactics used by the Romans to successfully annex the unconquered Alps. A team of archaeologists, forensic and ballistics experts reconstruct the campaign. The findings reveal how Roman soldiers coped in the harsh mountain conditions during the conquest

programme.title: Building Sights
programme.desc: Architect Sand Helsel applauds Trellick Tower, a brutalist tower block in west London, designed by Erno Goldfinger and completed in 1972. First broadcast February 5, 1991

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox examines Jupiter, the largest and oldest planet in the solar system, revealing how its immense gravity influenced where other planets developed, destroying several nascent planets and negatively influencing the development of Mars. Today, Jupiter's great mass continues to be felt. Its gravity torments its moon Io, creating the most volcanically active body in the solar system. And through the vice-like grip it exerts over the asteroid belt, Jupiter's influence extends as far as Earth

programme.title: The Singing Detective
programme.desc: In the detective story playing out in Marlow's head, his fictional private eye pursues the two mysterious men - but back in the real world, the author receives a shock when he spots the same two men on the ward. He then has another session with Dr Gibbon, in which he recalls a disturbing incident with his mother. Meanwhile, Nicola and Mark continue their fraudulent plan

programme.title: The Singing Detective
programme.desc: Michael Gambon stars in the conclusion of Dennis Potter's surreal 1986 drama. Dr Gibbon coaxes Philip into revealing more about his childhood traumas, leading his various fictions and memories to intertwine. The characters become angry, and seek retribution on their creator, while the sinister figure of the scarecrow stalks the wards

programme.title: Timewatch
programme.desc: An investigation into the Gunpowder Plot of 1605. The programme focuses on how a group of Catholic Englishmen became so radicalised and intent on mass murder they attempted to destroy the Houses of Parliament. State-of-the-art CGI shows the building as it would have looked, and the extent of the damage if the explosion had taken place

Oscar-winning Second World War adventure, based on Alistair MacLean's novel, starring Gregory Peck, David Niven, Anthony Quinn, Stanley Baker, Anthony Quayle and Irene Papas

programme.desc: Homicidal madman Michael Myers escapes from a mental institution 15 years after murdering his sister, and goes on a killing spree in his home town. Although a psychiatrist is quickly on his trail in a bid to stop the loss of more lives, a shy teenage girl babysitting for her neighbour is unaware of the grisly fate in store for her. John Carpenter's horror, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Donald Pleasence, Nick Castle and PJ Soles

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: A look at stories surrounding the ghost of 17th-century Edinburgh executioner George Mackenzie that sprung up in 1998 after a homeless man broke into his tomb and fell into an assembly of decomposing corpses. Within weeks, stories of blackouts and inexplicable attacks began to spread, with Edinburgh City Council locking the gates and declaring the area out of bounds for public safety. Jan Andrew Henderson began to chronicle the Mackenzie Poltergeist - only to claim to become a target of its malice

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: A look at a 1958 case in which two women travelled together to a nightclub near Lake Lanier in the US state Georgia, but never returned. Weeks later, reports began of a ghostly figure of woman in a blue dress walking across the lake, while calls for help were heard from the water below, before stories of unexplained drownings emerged. Mysterious deaths at Lake Lanier abound, whilst survivors report the feeling of being pulled into the depths or held beneath by unseen hands.

programme.title: Inside Classical

programme.title: Gaia: A Death on Dancing Ledge
programme.desc: Zara McDermott revisits the case of 19-year-old Gaia Pope-Sutherland, highlighting her family's search for truth and justice in the wake of her untimely death from hypothermia. Gaia's alleged attacker contacted her 10 months before she went missing. As her attempts to get a restraining order were declined, her state of mind deteriorated, requiring her to be sectioned under the Mental Health Act. The inquest into Gaia's death - one of the longest in British history - revealed vital clues into her final weeks, unearthing over 50 missed opportunities in her care and search for her

After witnessing the death of her father at the hands of Sarfaraz Khan, young British woman Ruth is understandably traumatised. And Sarfaraz's brother-in-law, surly Pathan chieftain Javed, is in love with Ruth, even though he's never even talked to her. Now that the British are in danger from the rebellion, Javed seizes the opportunity to get Ruth and her mother, Miriam, and grandmother under his roof, with the intention of making the object of his obsession his wife. programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Chandler begins a relationship with a married woman, Ross tries to liven up his conservative image and Joey lands a film role with a difference - as a naked body-double for Al Pacino

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

New DS Charlie Zailer finds herself working with DC Simon Waterhouse for the first time when Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, and the two argue about whether the case is one of murder, suicide or something more sinister. Meanwhile, a woman tells her best friend she had an affair with Bretherick's husband and wants to see him again. Thriller, based on the novel Point of Rescue by Sophie Hannah, starring Olivia Williams, Darren Boyd, Rupert Graves and Amy Beth Hayes

programme.title: Hussy (1980)
programme.desc: A prostitute works out of a seedy London nightclub to support her son. She begins a relationship with a mysterious American, but their relationship is threatened by both her career and his murky past, especially when an old friend of her lover appears with a criminal scheme in mind. Drama, starring Helen Mirren and John Shea

programme.title: Cruel Passion (1977)
programme.desc: Two sisters are expelled from a nunnery and are plunged into a life of debauchery. While one embraces her new lifestyle, the other is desperate to cling to her old morality and sees a hope of salvation in a mysterious aristocrat who harbours a hidden dark side. Historical drama based on the novel Justine by the Marquis de Sade, starring Koo Stark and Martin Potter

programme.title: Edwardian Farm
programme.desc: Spring sees the daffodil harvest, accompanied by a rush to get the flowers off to the train station so they can be delivered to towns and cities across the country within hours of being picked. Alex Langlands and Peter Ginn go to Dartmoor for the annual pony trek, and use the occasion to purchase one of the beasts for the farm. However, before their new pony is fit for work, he needs to be trained, and the farmers hire American horse whisperer Mike Branch for the job. Meanwhile, the arrival of new lambs is followed by a pleasant surprise for Ruth Goodman in the run-up to Mother's Day

programme.title: Wild West: America's Great Frontier
programme.desc: A journey along America's West coast. The programme examines how the landscape is shaped by the Pacific Ocean as well as powerful forces beneath ground, particularly along the San Andreas Fault. The programme also visits the warm and sheltered waters of the Sea of Cortez, where animals including blue whales gather, and discovers how a small community in America's westernmost point have a unique relationship with grey whales

programme.title: Attenborough's Wonder of Song
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines seven recordings of animals singing, all documented in his lifetime - including one he recorded himself. The songs are from species as varied as lyrebirds, lemurs and humpback whales, all providing an insight into the way these creatures communicate. The programme also examines new evidence on the purpose of singing, which challenges the long-held belief that it is a mating ritual - it has been theorised that both male and female songbirds sing as part of a survival strategy

programme.title: Wild West: America's Great Frontier
programme.desc: A journey along America's West coast. The programme examines how the landscape is shaped by the Pacific Ocean as well as powerful forces beneath ground, particularly along the San Andreas Fault. The programme also visits the warm and sheltered waters of the Sea of Cortez, where animals including blue whales gather, and discovers how a small community in America's westernmost point have a unique relationship with grey whales

programme.title: Attenborough's Wonder of Song
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines seven recordings of animals singing, all documented in his lifetime - including one he recorded himself. The songs are from species as varied as lyrebirds, lemurs and humpback whales, all providing an insight into the way these creatures communicate. The programme also examines new evidence on the purpose of singing, which challenges the long-held belief that it is a mating ritual - it has been theorised that both male and female songbirds sing as part of a survival strategy

programme.desc: A baby is kidnapped from outside the post office, causing emotions to run high in Aidensfield. programme.desc: First-ever episode of the popular crime drama, starring John Thaw as author Colin Dexter's Oxford detective who treats his cases as intellectual challenges. Co-starring Gemma Jones, Patrick Troughton, James Grout and Peter Woodthorpe

programme.title: Posh Pawn

programme.title: Mountain Vets
programme.desc: On-call vets Rosalind and Aidan tackle the weekend shift in the busy spring calving season. programme.title: My Unique B&B
programme.desc: Simon Parfett and his team head to the Black Mountains in south-east Wales to help Alex and Laura finish building a tiny house on wheels

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: As Christmas comes to Aidensfield, the locals have their very own Scrooge to contend with in the shape of mean-spirited bank manager Gordon Stringer. With farmer Jack Dugdale at his mercy and Greengrass on the prowl for money he is owed, his son Noel becomes fed up of taking the flak for his father's unpopularity and runs away. Drama, starring Jason Durr, Bill Maynard, Mark Jordon and Tricia Penrose

programme.title: Upstairs, Downstairs
programme.desc: Sarah falls for the manservant of Capt Ryttsen, a dashing Swedish army officer who is staying in the Bellamy household as a guest of James, but later finds herself suspected of betraying her employers' trust by stealing from them. Vintage drama, starring Pauline Collins and Simon Williams

programme.title: Paddington Station 24/7
programme.desc: Behind-the-scenes activities at one of the UK's busiest transport hubs, chronicling the typical and not-so-typical issues that face station staff, transport workers, emergency services, commuters, tourists and everyone in between

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Graham receives instructions from the kidnapper, while Caleb is furious and Sadie plays the innocent

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Ross's goading results in a violent outburst from Tyrone, Sally puts her foot down with Lucy, Ryan takes care of a grateful Bethany, and Debbie gives Adam a ring

programme.title: The Royal
programme.desc: Ormerod faces a testing time when his father-in-law arrives demanding to know whether he was seeing Dr Weatherill while his late daughter was still alive. Following a heated exchange, it emerges that the disgruntled patriarch has hired a private detective to investigate the couple - but the situation only serves to bring them closer together, culminating in a marriage proposal. At the Royal, a painfully thin girl causes concern for Goodwin - whose green-eyed monster emerges when student nurse Samantha Beaumont agrees to a date with a younger man - and the hospital is evacuated after a suicide victim's corpse is brought in emitting toxic fumes. Medical drama, starring Robert Daws, Amy Robbins, Paul Fox and Anna Madeley

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Marple
programme.desc: The sleuthing spinster teams up with a dashing man to investigate a series of poison-pen letters in the sleepy village of Lymstock. Two of the missives have led to the deaths of Mona Symmington, the wife of Lymstock solicitor Richard, and Agnes Woddell, the parlour maid at the Symmingtons' house. However, Miss Marple suspects there is more to these deaths than meets the eye. Murder mystery with an all-star cast, featuring Geraldine McEwan, James D'Arcy, Emilia Fox, Imogen Stubbs, Ken Russell, Harry Enfield and Kelly Brook

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: Maggie's suspicions are aroused by the death of a close friend's mother, so she goes straight to the police to report her fears, leading to a cruel dilemma. The district nurse's emotional day comes to an end when she announces her decision to leave Aidensfield, prompting the locals to throw a farewell party. Meanwhile, jealousy rears its ugly head when one of Blaketon's old flames comes back on the scene and starts taking an interest in Lord Ashfordly. Rural drama, starring Kazia Pelka, Derek Fowlds and Janie Dee

programme.title: The Hack
programme.desc: As the hacking scandal builds momentum, Nick meets with Dave's new ally Gordon Brown, who persuades him that there is still work to be done. Nick then teams up with fellow Guardian journalist Amelia Hill, who has a source within the Met's new hacking investigation. Meanwhile, a tip-off from Charlotte Harris leads Nick to wonder if hacking was far more egregious, and the information he discovers next has the potential to blow the hacking scandal wide open.

programme.title: Mr Bates vs the Post Office: The Impact
programme.desc: In January 2024, the drama series Mr Bates vs The Post Office brought the story of the faulty Horizon computer and the subpostmasters wrongfully accused of theft to a national audience. In this follow-up documentary, the former subpostmasters and subpostmistresses involved talk about the impact of the drama, while more come forward to tell their heart-breaking stories. Narrated by Toby Jones

programme.title: Showtrial
programme.desc: Time is running out for Cleo and Talitha as the trial reaches its explosive conclusion. After the prosecution rests, Dhillon and Talitha each have the chance to give their account of what happened between them and Hannah. Meanwhile, Cleo and James both face hard decisions as they attempt to ensure a fair trial. Professional relationships are pushed to the limit, as James wrestles with his conscience, and Cleo chooses to defy Damian
